category_title: Students with aggressive behaviors and impulse control difficulties in urban environments
scenario_title: Transitioning to circle time and group activity
minimal_context: Dominic is transitioning from free choice time with blocks to cleanup and sitting in circle time to learn about bird calls.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time to clean up the blocks and transition to circle time so we can look at the stuffed-animal birds.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Hits another child and takes their blocks away) No!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Dominic, please stop hitting and put the blocks away.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Holds onto his small accordion tightly and displays angry behavior) I am not going to the circle.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to clean up the blocks now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Becomes frustrated and engages in destructive behavior, throwing the blocks) No cleanup!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time to clean up the blocks and transition to circle time so we can look at the stuffed-animal birds.

STUDENT: (Hits another child and takes their blocks away) No!

TUTOR: Dominic, please stop hitting and put the blocks away.

STUDENT: (Holds onto his small accordion tightly and displays angry behavior) I am not going to the circle.

TUTOR: We need to clean up the blocks now.

STUDENT: (Becomes frustrated and engages in destructive behavior, throwing the blocks) No cleanup!

task.content: Transitioning from free choice to cleanup and sitting in circle time

context.materials: blocks, collection of stuffed-animal birds, small accordion
context.time_context: As children transitioned from free choice to cleanup

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: As children transitioned from free choice to cleanup
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: become frustrated and engage in destructive behavior, such as throwing blocks
